name: nejm-careercenter-scraper
title: NEJM CareerCenter Scraper: Physician Jobs
description: Scrape physician and healthcare job listings from NEJM CareerCenter: title, employer, location, salary and, on request, the full text, specialty and posting dates. Pay-per-event.
readme:
# NEJM CareerCenter Scraper Scrape physician and healthcare job listings from NEJM CareerCenter ([nejmcareercenter.org](https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/)), the job board of the New England Journal of Medicine. You get the title, employer, location, salary text with parsed amounts when the advertiser states them, and the New and Featured badges for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full description, the exact posting and closing time, the employer page, specialty, position type, telehealth flag and recruiter details. Search by keyword and the site's own filters (specialty, location, telehealth, position type, recruiter type), sort by newest first, or start from any NEJM CareerCenter jobs address. ## What you get - One row per job, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, with the currency) when the salary text names amounts such as "$150,000 - $170,000", "Up to $90,000" or "Starting at $200,000". - Optional job page details: exact posting and closing time, full description as HTML and plain text, employer page, recruiter type, employment types, country code, the job page's labelled Specialty, Position Type and Telehealth rows. These columns are filled only with the job page option on (detail-only columns): `company_id`, `company_url`, `city`, `region`, `country_code`, `location_terms`, `description_html`, `description_text`, `date_posted`, `valid_through`, `recruiter_id`, `recruiter_type`, `application_method`, `listing_type`, `direct_apply`, `employment_types`, `specialties`, `position_types`, `telehealth`. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with an input that has none of the fields below returns 5 jobs for the keyword physician. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/nejm-careercenter-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `nejm-careercenter-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "physician" (physician roles). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "physician" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to read the newest jobs. | | `startUrls` | NEJM CareerCenter addresses: `https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/jobs/` or `https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/jobs/cardiology/united-states/?Keywords=physician`. Only the Keywords and sort=Date parameters are kept. A `/searchjobs/` address with only Keywords is read as `/jobs/?Keywords=...`; any other `/searchjobs/` address is skipped with a warning, because this actor reads only the `/jobs/` pages. Reading starts at page 1. Addresses for emailjob, previewjob, apply-profile, analytics and invalid-request are rejected with a message in the run status. | | `specialties` | anesthesiology, cardiology, chiefs-directors-dept-heads, emergency-medicine, family-medicine, gastroenterology, hematology-oncology, hospitalist, internal-medicine, neurology, obstetrics-and-gynecology, pediatrics-general, psychiatry, radiology, urology. Other specialties such as infectious-disease work too. | | `locations` | united-states, asia, north-america, oceania, middle-east, nationwide, asia-pacific. A state or city slug such as california works too. | | `telehealth` | yes, no. | | `positionTypes` | permanent, locum-tenens. | | `recruiterTypes` | direct-employer, recruitment-consultant. | | `sortBy` | `relevance` (the site's default order) or `date` (newest first, the site's own `sort=Date` link). | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword or start URL. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. Each job with a fetched job page adds the job-detail event (see Pricing). | The filters are the path slugs of the site's browse list, for example `/jobs/cardiology/united-states/`. The site lists only its top links per filter, so the fields take free text: a value is lower-cased, spaces and `&` become `-`, and only letters, digits and `-` are kept. The slugs above are the ones seen on the site; others may work. Every request uses this browse path (`/jobs/`, never `/searchjobs/`). One search runs per keyword and per combination of one value from each filter you fill (at most 60 searches per run). When all values of a filter cannot be used, the run reads nothing and ends with 0 jobs. Examples: ```json { "searchQueries": ["hospitalist"], "locations": ["united-states"], "maxResults": 30 } ``` ```json { "specialties": ["cardiology"], "positionTypes": ["locum-tenens"], "sortBy": "date" } ``` ## Sample output ```json { "id": "1047342", "title": "Pediatric Infectious Disease Physician", "slug": "pediatric-infectious-disease-physician", "company": "Loma Linda University Faculty Medical Group", "company_id": "9be16d8d-5cce-4444-9dcc-6957ef59d911", "company_url": "https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/employer/9be16d8d-5cce-4444-9dcc-6957ef59d911/loma-linda-university-faculty-medical-group", "company_logo": "https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/_/jobseekers-frontend/image/cd3ebc80-962b-4762-bde4-d89359104e50", "location": "Loma Linda, California", "city": "Loma Linda", "region": "California", "country_code": "US", "location_terms": [ "San Bernardino County", "California", "United States", "North America", "Loma Linda" ], "salary_text": "$238,000 - $278,000", "salary_min": 238000, "salary_max": 278000, "salary_currency": "USD", "description_short": "Loma Linda University Faculty Medical Group, Department of Pediatrics, has an immediate need for a full-time Assistant/Associate Professor o...", "description_html": "

Loma Linda University Faculty Medical Group, Department of Pediatrics, has an immediate need for a full-time Assistant/Associate Professor of Pediatric Infec...", "description_text": "Loma Linda University Faculty Medical Group, Department of Pediatrics, has an immediate need for a full-time Assistant/Associate Professor of Pediatric Infectio...", "date_posted": "2026-11-10T13:20:00.000Z", "valid_through": "2026-12-11T04:59:00.000Z", "is_new": false, "is_featured": false, "recruiter_id": "69418", "recruiter_type": "Direct Employer", "application_method": "Email", "listing_type": "Premium Job", "direct_apply": true, "employment_types": [ "FULL_TIME" ], "specialties": [ "Infectious Disease" ], "position_types": [ "Permanent" ], "telehealth": "No", "job_url": "https://www.nejmcareercenter.org/job/1047342/pediatric-infectious-disease-physician/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "physician", "source": "nejmcareercenter.org", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric job id: the number in the job address /job///. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the listing. | | `slug` | string, null | Text part of the job address. | | `company` | string, null | Employer name as shown on the listing. | | `company_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Id of the employer page (the uuid in /employer//). | | `company_url` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employer profile page on NEJM CareerCenter. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the employer. | | `location` | string, null | Location text as shown ('City, State'). | | `city` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). City from the job posting data. | | `region` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). State from the job posting data. | | `country_code` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Country code from the job posting data, for example US. The list pages show no country. Null when absent. | | `location_terms` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Location hierarchy terms of the job, from the county up to the continent. Empty when the page has none. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as typed by the advertiser, for example 'Competitive' or '$150,000 - $170,000'. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound, read from the salary text when it states amounts ("$150,000 - $170,000", "Starting at $200,000"). Null otherwise. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound, read from the salary text. "Up to X" gives only the maximum. Null otherwise. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | ISO currency of the amounts that were read (US dollar, euro or pound codes), else null. | | `description_short` | string, null | Teaser text of the listing card. | | `description_html` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as HTML. | | `description_text` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as plain text. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Exact posting time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Closing time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `is_new` | boolean | True when the card carries the green 'New' badge. | | `is_featured` | boolean | True when the card is a premium, featured or showcase listing. | | `recruiter_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Internal id of the recruiter or employer account, as given in the page data. | | `recruiter_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Type of recruiter, for example Direct Employer. | | `application_method` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). How applications are taken, for example Email or ExternalRedirect. | | `listing_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Listing product of the job, for example Admin Max. | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). directApply flag of the job posting data. | | `employment_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employment types from the job posting data (TEMPORARY, FULL_TIME, ...). Empty when none. | | `specialties` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Specialty labels of the job page. Empty when none. | | `position_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Position type labels of the job page (Permanent, Locum Tenens). Empty when none. | | `telehealth` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Telehealth label of the job page, Yes or No. Null when absent. | | `job_url` | string | Job page on NEJM CareerCenter. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword, start URL or 'all jobs' that found the job. | | `source` | string | Source host. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was built, ISO 8601 (UTC). | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts, one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset, and, only with `includeDetails` on, one `job-detail` event for each job whose job page was fetched and read. A job whose job page could not be read is delivered with its list fields and charged only the `job-result` event. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). With details on, each job with a fetched detail page adds $0.003 (job-detail event). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [HealtheCareers Scraper: US Healthcare Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/healthecareers-scraper): US healthcare jobs from Health eCareers. - [BioSpace Scraper - Biotech & Pharma Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/biospace-scraper): Biotech and pharma jobs from BioSpace. - [NHS Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/nhs-jobs-scraper): Health service jobs in the UK from NHS Jobs. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one search return?** A search or the job list shows 20 jobs per page. The actor reads page after page until the site's result count is reached, the last page is reached, or your limit is reached (at most 1000 jobs per search). The board holds about 11,800 jobs (11,779 on 2026-11-11). **Is the posting date exact?** With `includeDetails` on, yes: `date_posted` and `valid_through` come from the job page. The list pages show no posting date, so those two columns are empty with details off. **Why is the salary parsed for only some jobs?** Advertisers type the salary freely, and many jobs show only "Competitive" or "DOE". Such texts are returned as `salary_text` only. The numbers `salary_min`, `salary_max` and `salary_currency` are filled when the text names an amount in dollars, euros or pounds. **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged for jobs. **Does it need residential proxies?** Yes. The site's firewall answers Apify datacenter IPs with an "Access Denied" page on every try, so the actor loads every page through the Apify RESIDENTIAL proxy group, which your Apify plan must include. A page that still comes back as a firewall page is retried twice on a new session and then skipped with a warning. If a job page cannot be read, the row is delivered with its list fields only, without the job-detail charge, and the run status says how many job pages were missed. If list pages cannot be read at all, the run ends with a clear "Blocked" status. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/nejm-careercenter-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
